claim: For the reciprocal subgraph of the independent two-uniform-weight random threshold digraph on \(n\ge2\) vertices, the degree mass function is \(\Pr(D_i=k)=(H_n-H_k)/n\), and the number \(Z_n\) of vertices of reciprocal degree zero has \(\mathbb E Z_n=H_n\), \(\operatorname{Var}(Z_n)\sim3\log n\), and \(Z_n/\log n\to1\) in probability.
scientific_integrity: An analytical proof and a standard-library standalone checker accompany this record. Same-model review of correctness, originality and value is reported separately; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The variance coefficient is asymptotic only; no central limit theorem, finite-n closed variance, general weight distribution, or arbitrary directed graphon extension is claimed. Historical-priority searches are not exhaustive. The standalone checker verifies finite identities and simulations, not the infinite limit.
title: Harmonic reciprocal-degree spectrum and threefold isolation variance in random threshold digraphs
